intro.en: A good prompt says who the model is, what to do, with which data and in which form. The exam shows a weak prompt and asks for the best improvement.
intro.ro: Acha prompt batata hai ke model kaun hai, kya karna hai, kis data se aur kis shakal mein. Exam kamzor prompt dikha kar behtareen tabdeeli poochta hai.

text.en: Lasting rules for all turns: role, scope, tone, format, what to refuse.
text.ro: Tamam turns ke mustaqil usool: role, daira, andaz, format, kis se inkaar.

text.en: The task or question of this turn, with its data.
text.ro: Is turn ka kaam ya sawal, apne data ke saath.

text.en: Pairs of input and ideal output teach format and style. Zero-shot has none.
text.ro: Input aur ideal output ke jore format aur andaz sikhate hain. Zero-shot mein misaal nahi hoti.

text.en: Marks such as --- or tags separate instructions from data.
text.ro: --- ya tags jaise nishan instructions ko data se alag karte hain.

text.en: Give the source and say: answer only from it, otherwise say that you do not know.
text.ro: Source dein aur kahein: sirf isi se jawab do, warna kaho ke nahi pata.

text.en: Breaking a task into steps helps with complex work; reasoning models do it by themselves.
text.ro: Kaam ko qadmon mein baantna mushkil kaam mein madad karta hai; reasoning models khud karte hain.

text.en: A JSON schema forces the keys and types of the reply.
text.ro: JSON schema jawab ki keys aur types lazmi banata hai.

text.en: Text in data tries to give orders. Treat data as data and use Prompt Shields.
text.ro: Data ka text hukm dene ki koshish karta hai. Data ko data samjhein aur Prompt Shields lagayein.

text.en: Weak: "Summarize this." The strong version sets the role, audience, length, format and limits:
text.ro: Kamzor: "Summarize this." Mazboot shakal role, parhne wale, lambai, format aur hadein batati hai:

example.code:
System: You are a support editor. Use only the text between the lines.
User: Summarize the text for a manager in 3 bullet points,
each under 15 words. If the cause is missing, write "cause unknown".
---
<ticket text>
---

rows.en: Scope and refusal rule in the system message
rows.ro: System message mein daira aur inkaar ka usool

rows.en: Grounding text and "say you do not know"
State the length; max output tokens as a limit
rows.ro: Lambai likhein; had ke liye max output tokens

remember.en: Lasting rules go in the system message; changing data goes in the user message.
remember.ro: Mustaqil usool system message mein; badalta data user message mein.

remember.en: Say what to do, not only what to avoid.
remember.ro: Sirf ye nahi ke kya na karein; batayein kya karein.

remember.en: Examples guide the format; a schema guarantees it.
remember.ro: Misalein format ki rehnumai karti hain; schema us ki guarantee deta hai.

remember.en: A system message guides the model but is not a security control by itself.
remember.ro: System message model ki rehnumai karta hai lekin akela security control nahi.

traps.en: Max output tokens cuts the answer off; it does not make it concise.
traps.ro: Max output tokens jawab kaat deta hai; mukhtasar nahi banata.

traps.en: Never put keys or secrets in a system message.
traps.ro: Keys ya secrets kabhi system message mein na rakhein.
